title: Geologic map of the Cape Fear region, Florence 1 degree x 2 degrees quadrangle and northern half of the Georgetown 1 degree x 2 degrees quadrangle, North Carolina and South Carolina
citation: Owens, J.P., 1990, Geologic map of the Cape Fear region, Florence 1 degree x 2 degrees quadrangle and northern half of the Georgetown 1 degree x 2 degrees quadrangle, North Carolina and South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Miscellaneous Investigations Series Map I-1948-A, map scale 1:250,000.
notes: Two-state map (NC and SC); only units present in South Carolina and South Carolina localities recorded. Skipped as North Carolina only: upland gravels, 'Pinehurst' Formation, Castle Hayne Limestone, Cape Fear Formation outcrop description (it is recorded only as a corehole interval), Jurassic-Triassic rocks, gabbro, Lilesville Granite, mica gneiss and schist, argillite, phyllitic rocks, and NC localities (Southport hole, Holden Beach, Snows Cut and others). Map face (sheet 1) OCR is garbled; no map-face values recorded. Britton Neck corehole MRN-78 (figure 2) formation boundaries were read from the page image; the depth column is labelled meters but its numbers fit feet (text: 374-m-deep hole; Bladen about 44 m = 216 to 362 on the scale), so all depths are marked unclear and no surfaces were derived. Text thicknesses from the corehole (Donoho Creek about 18 m, Tar Heel 55 m) do not match the drawn boundaries read as feet (about 30 m and about 70 m). Generalized cross sections A-A' to G-G' (sheet 2, vertical exaggeration 35x) were not read; they need an image re-read. Black Creek Group, Peedee and Middendorf in this packet use the author's new nomenclature (Black Creek raised to group).
